title: Managed Database: invoice issuance
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database invoice issuance applies to database charge. No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. Group service charges by invoice grouping. Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month. For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records. Set invoice issue time to the current handling time. Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge. A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge. The fixed source reference and source type distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

## Evidence: unbilled source component
No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, original source reference, meter classification, source type, effective price component, period, event type, status. The correlated evidence must refer together to original source reference.
